title: Placement & Industry Relations Manager
description:
**About EjobIndia** 




 EjobIndia, a unit of OS4Ed India Pvt. Ltd., has been training aspiring IT professionals since 2005\. With 20\+ years of experience in software training and a strong network of
 **200\+ software companies** 
 , we focus on helping our students build careers in the IT industry.
 



 Our training programs cover
 **AI Engineering, Full Stack Development, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Data Engineering, and other job\-oriented technologies.** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Placement \& Industry Relations Manager** 
 who can take ownership of student placements and build strong relationships with software companies for fresher recruitment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Arrange and coordinate
 **interviews for our trained students** 
 with software companies in Kolkata.
* Identify relevant
 **fresher job opportunities** 
 through job portals, LinkedIn, company websites, online communities, and other sources.
* Actively follow up with our network of
 **200\+ software companies** 
 to identify current and upcoming hiring requirements.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR teams, recruiters, hiring managers, and company representatives.
* Connect with companies regularly through
 **phone calls, email, and other communication channels** 
 to generate placement opportunities.
* Visit companies directly whenever required to develop relationships and explore recruitment opportunities.
* Develop new corporate relationships and establish
 **recruitment tie\-ups with larger software companies** 
 .
* Understand the hiring requirements of companies and coordinate suitable student profiles accordingly.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with companies regarding interview schedules, candidate feedback and selection status.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Minimum
 **3 years of relevant experience** 
 in placement, recruitment, corporate relations, or a similar role, preferably within the
 **software/IT industry** 
 .
* Strong understanding of the
 **Kolkata software/IT recruitment market** 
 .
* Existing relationships with software companies and HR/recruitment professionals will be an advantage.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable making frequent
 **outbound calls and following up with companies** 
 .
* Willingness to meet company representatives and
 **visit companies when required** 
 .
* Ability to independently identify opportunities and convert them into interview/placement opportunities.
* Strong follow\-up, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Candidates with experience in
 **IT recruitment, campus recruitment, training \& placement, staffing or corporate tie\-ups** 
 are encouraged to apply.



  





**Why Join EjobIndia?** 



* Work with a well\-established IT training organisation with
 **20\+ years of experience** 
 .
* Work directly with a large network of software companies.
* Opportunity to build and expand corporate relationships across the IT industry.
* Exposure to emerging technologies including
 **AI Engineering, Generative AI, Agentic AI and Full Stack Development** 
 .



  





**If you have strong connections in the IT industry and are passionate about creating employment opportunities for freshers, we'd like to hear from you.** 




  





**Apply now and become a key part of EjobIndia's industry\-placement team.**

title: Assistant Director - Placement & Corporate Relations
description:
**Amity University Kolkata** 
 is looking for dynamic and experienced professionals to join its
 **Placement \& Training team** 
 and drive industry engagement, student employability and campus recruitment initiatives.
 



  





**Deputy Director / Assistant Director – Placement \& Corporate Relations** 




  





**Location:** 
 Kolkata, West Bengal
 



**Experience:** 
 15\+ Years
 



**Qualification:** 
 Master's Degree in Management / MBA / HR / relevant discipline
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the university's overall placement and corporate relations strategy.
* Manage end\-to\-end campus placement and recruitment activities.
* Build and strengthen relationships with
 **MNCs, corporates, start\-ups and industry leaders** 
 .
* Facilitate student training in
 **Aptitude, GD, PI, Communication, Resume Building \& Corporate Etiquette** 
 .
* Drive campus placements, internships, PPOs and industry projects.
* Develop and execute student employability and career\-readiness programs.
* Lead the Placement \& Training team and establish measurable KPIs.
* Organize recruitment drives, career fairs, industry interactions and leadership sessions.
* Monitor placement analytics, recruiter engagement and placement outcomes.
* Organize career fairs, workshops and industry interaction programs.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 ·      Strong corporate \& recruiter network
 



 ·      Experience in campus recruitment / higher education placements
 



 ·      Excellent communication \& negotiation skills
 



 ·      Strong stakeholder and relationship management
 



 ·      Team leadership and execution capabilities
 



 ·      Data\-driven approach to placement management
 



  





 📩
 **Interested candidates can share their updated CV at sjsahoo@amity.edu**

title: Female HR Recruiter Urgently Required Rajarhat, Kolkata - ( Job ID - 24234)
description:
**Job Description: Female HR Recruiter** 
  





  




**Job Location:** 
 Atghara, Rajarhat, Kolkata
   

**Industry:** 
 Plywood Manufacturing
   

**Designation:** 
 HR Recruiter
   

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time / On\-Site
   

**Experience Required:** 
 1–3 Years
   

**Salary:** 
 ₹15,000–₹20,000 per month
   

**Gender:** 
 Female
   


  





**Role Summary** 
  





 A plywood manufacturing company is looking for a
 **Female HR Recruiter** 
 to manage day\-to\-day recruitment activities and support the organization in meeting its manpower requirements.
   





 The candidate will be responsible for sourcing suitable candidates, screening profiles, coordinating interviews, maintaining recruitment records and ensuring timely joining of selected candidates.
   





 The role is
 **fully office\-based** 
 at Atghara, Rajarhat, Kolkata and is
 **not a Work From Home position** 
 .
   





**Key Responsibilities** 
  





**Recruitment \& Talent Sourcing** 
  




* Understand manpower requirements from different departments.
* Source candidates through job portals, recruitment platforms, references, social media and other suitable channels.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
* Conduct initial telephonic screening and candidate assessments.
* Coordinate interview schedules with candidates and concerned departments.
* Follow up with selected candidates regarding documentation and joining.
* Maintain an updated recruitment pipeline and candidate database.
* Ensure timely closure of assigned vacancies.



**Candidate Coordination** 
  




* Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Explain job responsibilities, salary, location, working conditions and other relevant details.
* Follow up with candidates after interviews and coordinate subsequent rounds.
* Maintain proper records of selected, rejected and pending candidates.
* Ensure a smooth candidate joining and onboarding process.



**HR Support** 
  




* Maintain recruitment\-related documentation and records.
* Prepare recruitment reports and provide regular updates to management.
* Support basic HR activities as required.
* Coordinate with departments regarding manpower requirements and recruitment status.



**Candidate Requirements** 
  




* **Female candidates preferred.**
* Graduate in any discipline; HR / Business Administration qualification will be an advantage.
* **1–3 years of experience in recruitment / HR recruitment** 
 preferred.
* Good knowledge of recruitment processes and candidate sourcing.
* Good working knowledge of job portals and recruitment channels.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, Excel and email communication.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to handle multiple vacancies and candidates simultaneously.



**Language Skills – Mandatory** 
  





 The candidate should be comfortable speaking and communicating in:
   




* **English**
* **Hindi**
* **Bengali**



 Good spoken communication in all three languages is required for effective candidate interaction and coordination.
   





**Desired Skills** 
  




* Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
* Candidate Sourcing
* Resume Screening
* Telephonic Screening
* Interview Coordination
* Candidate Follow\-up
* Joining \& Onboarding Coordination
* Recruitment MIS
* MS Excel
* Job Portals
* Communication \& Interpersonal Skills



**Work Location \& Working Arrangement** 
  




* **Location:** 
 Atghara, Rajarhat, Kolkata
* **Work Mode:** 
 Work from Office
* **WFH / Remote Work:** 
 Not applicable



**Ideal Candidate** 
  





 The ideal candidate should be a
 **confident and proactive female HR professional** 
 with good recruitment experience, excellent communication skills and strong follow\-up abilities.
   





 She should be comfortable communicating with candidates in
 **English, Hindi and Bengali** 
 and should be capable of independently handling the recruitment cycle from sourcing to joining.
   





**Compensation** 
  





**Salary: ₹15,000–₹20,000 per month** 
 , depending on experience, recruitment skills and overall suitability.
   





**To Apply** 
  





 Interested candidates may send their updated CV to
 **sudhir@educohire.com** 
 with the subject line
 **“Application for Female HR Recruiter – Atghara, Rajarhat”** 
 .
   





 For queries, contact
 **9205582778** 
 .

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
